verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published list of supported languages and no statement of per-model or per-feature language differences. It only shows that the language parameter defaults to automatic detection, plus one community report of German usage. Language-coverage documentation is a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, the supported languages are published as a concrete list, with any per-model or per-feature differences stated
